body:
## Planning result: exact ΔH overhead budgets for centre-path sharing on the actual selected profiles (no new kappa)

**Card:** `centre-path-sharing` (recursive-interfaces track, seed `8daf9514…`), scope refined. [PR1708](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1708) and [PR1748](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/1748) construct the two-call shared centre phases, and PR1708 screened the ideal relaxation (+3.4536% cap). Their open blocker is the overhead **ΔH**.

This package prices the lever on the **actual** #1094 complex and PR589 bit histograms: real idle remainder, no ideal packing. Every budget is a **sharp integer**: that many extra paid children pass the exact moment test, and one more fails. [CLAIM](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/1516#discussioncomment-18921143). Base `0b1cccf8`. Adds only `research/centre-sharing-overhead-budget/` (6 files, stdlib, about 60 s).

### Results
- **With any sharing, the complex side stops binding.** For two-call sharing, `f(c) − 1 = −4.25·10⁻³` at the bit endpoint. κ becomes bit-limited at **0.001730427469823602 (+3.4536%)**, reproducing PR1708 on the actual histogram.

  | k calls sharing | overhead keeping the full +3.45% (paid mass per call, of 64(1−1/k) saved) |
  |---:|---:|
  | 2 | 30.66 (rank-1 overhead) / 30.72 (rank-8) |
  | 4 | 46.60 / 46.72 |
  | 8 | 54.57 / 54.72 |
  | 144 | 62.10 / 62.28 |
- **ΔH budget for two calls.** The budget is about **30.5–30.8 units per call** at any overhead rank from 1 to 72, for example 4,415 rank-1, 553 rank-8 or 92 rank-48 children in total. Any gain at all requires ΔH below about 32 units per call. Break-even control: re-adding 575 rank-8 children still gains; 576, which recreates the selected histogram, does not.
- **The complex side binds by only 1.23–1.33 paid-mass units per call.** Removing 177 rank-1, 23 rank-8 or 4 rank-48 children hands the binding role to the bit side.
- **The card's stop rule triggers on its own (ideal gain under 10%).** For **+10%** the bit endpoint must reach **0.0018433** (×1.0634). That needs a net bit-side reduction of **≥ 649 paid-mass units** (deficit 10,272 → ≥ 10,921; about 20.3 per replica of 32), with the surcharge recomputed. Centre sharing pays off for the headline only jointly with a bit mechanism of that size.
- **Scalar overhead is not the constraint.** Each extra macro adds 16 adapters at the compiler constant. The binding finite guard (`local_primitive_bound < 2⁴⁸`) leaves room for **≤ 654,144 extra macros per call**; PR1748's two-call reverse phase is 384 macros.

### Method and checks
- **Reused code:** Navinor's exact moment enclosure (`selected-suppliers-de-diagnostic`) and Wronskode's seed81 bootstrap and 47-slack outer formulas. Both are loaded **unchanged as Git blobs** at the base.
- **Pins:** the certificate, PR589 record and invoice receipt are hash-pinned.
- **Controls:** both selected endpoints are accepted and their next grid points rejected; the selected κ is recomputed; the bit surcharge reconstruction matches; every budget's sharpness is checked; the break-even control above; the script refuses `-O`.
- **Runs:** `--check-only` and the research tests pass.

### Limits
- **Not established:** a selected call pair with common post-A sinks, charts or ownership (PR1748's first blocker), native μ+1 precision, hosting or admission.
- **Overhead model:** ΔH is modeled as paid children of one rank. Overhead that changes the idle histogram, coverage identity or outer recipe is outside the model.
- **Bit side:** the bit numbers are removals from the PR589 histogram, not a construction.
- **Environment:** Windows, CPython 3.14; the registered 3.12 replay was not run locally.

### Credit
- **Sharing constructions:** 1337isnot1337 (PR1708) and ToikY (PR1748); priced here, not admitted.
- **Reused code:** Navinor and Wronskode.
- **Lever framing and coverage identity:** Douglas Colkitt (`complex-local-word-ceiling`) and PR1012.
- **Selected construction:** Rohan Arun (#1094) and its lineage.
